# Delta and Risk Pass

Boruch Hashem. Blessed is He.

> The Awtsmoos makes no promise through a filename alone; Awtsmoos.com must measure the light that truly reaches the rendered frame.

## Current delta

The canonical document, AI contract, feature vocabulary, mobile dock, and 180-second semantic composition exist. The planned renderer/showcase directories are absent at this checkpoint. Therefore semantic coverage is proven but rendered coverage is not yet proven.

## Main risks

1. A layer kind can exist in JSON while no renderer consumes it.
2. 3D labels can degrade into flat decoration instead of visible depth/camera behavior.
3. Keyframes can normalize correctly but never affect pixels.
4. Particles can vary nondeterministically and make verification flaky.
5. A 180-second declared duration can differ from encoded media duration.
6. Mobile UI can fit visually while controls remain too small or inaccessible.
7. Concurrent app changes can be overwritten by an integration pass.
8. Native editors can diverge from the canonical vocabulary.
9. AI commands can construct schema-valid but visually empty scenes.
10. Export can succeed while producing frozen or repeated frames.

## Corrections

The proof renderer will consume every canonical visual kind, use deterministic seeded particles, visibly alter perspective for camera kinds, and sample canonical keyframes. Verification will inspect representative frames from many timestamps, calculate frame hashes, confirm motion deltas, and probe encoded duration with ffprobe when available. App bridges will be tested as translations rather than source rewrites.

## Collision rule

New runtime and proof-tool files are owned by this pass. Existing dirty application entrypoints remain untouched unless a later read proves a safe merge is necessary.
